mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially increasing liraglutide exposure and risk of hypoglycemia; liraglutide may also increase gastroparesis risk which could affect tobramycin absorption if given orally.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; adjust liraglutide dose if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration during tobramycin therapy and monitor blood glucose levels for hypoglycemia.
